pages.islandDesc: Folded island size, compact indicator, and icon limits.
pages.mascotDesc: How often idle mascot activities switch.
pages.mediaDesc: Now Playing card, artwork backdrop, and lyrics.
pages.clipboardDesc: History recording and how many entries to keep.
pages.notificationsDesc: How new requests get your attention.
pages.shortcutsDesc: Summon the island and approve or deny requests from anywhere.
pages.sessionsDesc: Auto-archive idle sessions and completed subagents.

general.launchAtLoginDesc: Start Atoll automatically when you log in. Requires the installed Atoll.app from Applications.

usage.displayPricingDesc: Choose tokens or cost for each counter, and edit model rates.
usage.tokenActivityDesc: Daily token heatmap and usage history.

integrations.agentHooksDesc: Connect Claude Code, Codex, and future local agents.

display.smallFoldedIslandDesc: Use the smaller Windows folded island so pages under the top-center edge stay easier to click.
display.mediaCardDesc: Show the current macOS media track and playback controls in the idle island.
display.artworkBackdropDesc: Grow the now-playing artwork from its folded thumbnail into a frosted-glass backdrop when the island expands. Off by default.
display.lyricsDesc: Show timed lyrics scrolling through the folded island when media is playing. Off by default.
display.clipboardHistoryDesc: Record copied text, images and files for quick access. Off by default.
display.clipboardHistoryLimitDesc: Maximum number of clipboard entries kept.
display.compactIndicatorDesc: Choose what the folded island shows on the right: media artwork, token count, both, or nothing.
display.foldedIconLimitDescDefault: Max session icons in compact mode; extras spill to the right beside tokens.
display.foldedIconLimitDescLimited: Up to {{limit}} icons fit on this display; extras spill to the right beside tokens.
display.subagentDisplayLimitDesc: Max subagent chips shown per session; extras collapse to ×N.
display.sessionAutoArchiveDesc: Minutes before idle sessions are auto-archived. Pinned sessions are exempt.
display.subagentAutoArchiveDesc: Minutes after completion before subagents are auto-archived.

mascot.activityIntervalDesc: Minutes between random mascot activity switches.
mascot.activityDurationDesc: How long each activity plays before switching.

notice.modeInterruptDesc: New requests expand and focus the island right away for immediate handling. Default.
notice.modeNotifyDesc: Keep working undisturbed: a system notification arrives; click it or the island to open the approval.

shortcuts.enableDesc: Trigger island actions from any app. Approve and deny only fire while a request is pending.
shortcuts.needsModifierHint: Add a modifier such as Cmd, Ctrl, Alt, or Shift

usagePage.foldedCounterDesc: Active session counter in the folded island.
usagePage.expandedCounterDesc: Today's total in the expanded island header.
usagePage.settingsBadgeDesc: Summary shown on the Token activity entry card.
usagePage.heatmapDesc: Daily totals, tooltips, and trend charts on Token activity.
